task: Bug: `tenacity.after_log` crashes with `TypeError` when `retry_state.seconds_since_start` is `None` (it is `None` when the outcome timestamp has not been set). The log message should still be emitted, showing "?" in place of the elapsed seconds.
why:
Both candidates correctly emit “?” for missing elapsed time and preserve numeric formatting.
c1 wins on repository fidelity: its regression test reuses the existing retry-state helper and test setup.
Runner-up c2 bypasses those conventions with direct construction and fixed values, without adding coverage.
